name: Culinary Agents — NYC bartender search

parseRecipe.pagination: 24 cards per page; append &offset=N (N=24,48,...); stop when a page yields 0 cards. 139 unique across offsets 0-120 on test day. Plain `page=` params are IGNORED — only `offset` works.
parseRecipe.cardRegex: /<a class="ca-single-job-card[^"]*" data-entity="([^"]*)"[^>]*data-jobid="([^"]*)"[^>]*data-title="([^"]*)"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"/g — groups: venueName, jobId ("713145-821273", job id before the dash), title, relative href
parseRecipe.cardExtras: within the next ~2200 chars of each card anchor: pay line /job-employment">([^<]+)</ (e.g. "Part Time · Hourly ($25.00 - $35.00)"), address+cuisine line /<div class="text-muted text-ellipsis">([^<]*New York, NY[^<]*)<\/div>/, hospitality group is the FIRST text-muted div, freshness tag "Posted today" appears in card footer
parseRecipe.searchPageJsonLd: search page also embeds <script type="application/ld+json"> with @type SearchResultsPage → mainEntity.numberOfItems (140 on test day) + itemListElement[].url — cleanest way to get total count + all job URLs for page 1
parseRecipe.detailPage: GET https://culinaryagents.com/jobs/{id}-{slug} → single <script type="application/ld+json"> with a full schema.org JobPosting: title, datePosted, validThrough, employmentType, experienceRequirements, hiringOrganization.name (venue) + .url, baseSalary.value.{minValue,maxValue,unitText}, jobLocation.address.{streetAddress,addressLocality,postalCode}, jobLocation.geo.{latitude,longitude}, skills, description (HTML). One fetch = venue + pay + address + full listing text.

refreshCadence: daily (cards carry "Posted today"/"Posted N days ago" tags; sort is freshness-first)
notes: THE industry-standard NYC hospitality board — Major Food Group, Boulud, USHG etc. post here rather than running their own ATS. 108/138 bartender cards had an explicit "New York, NY" street address (Manhattan-heavy; filter by postal 100xx for strict Manhattan). Server-rendered Rails HTML, no auth, no cookies needed. Behind Cloudflare (cf-cache-status DYNAMIC) — plain node fetch with a desktop UA passed from residential; datacenter behavior untested, so treat Vercel fetches as needs-verification and keep a UA header on every request.

name: Greenhouse ATS — 550 Madison (COTE group / Bar Chimera)

parseRecipe.jsonPath: jobs[] → {title, absolute_url, location.name, updated_at}; filter title with /bartend|barback|cocktail server|drink runner|bar captain|mixolog/i
parseRecipe.locationQuirk: location.name is literally "550" (not "New York") for most roles on this board — do NOT NY-filter this slug, the whole venue is 550 Madison Ave, Midtown Manhattan
parseRecipe.detail: append ?content=true for full HTML descriptions, or GET /v1/boards/550/jobs/{id}

refreshCadence: every 6-12h is plenty (ATS postings turn over slowly)
notes: Bar roles on test day: Barback (550 Madison), Bartender (550 Madison), Cocktail Server (COTE 550), Drink Runner (550 Madison). Public CloudFront-served API, no auth, never IP-blocked.

name: Craigslist Manhattan food/bev/hosp — HTML search

parseRecipe.listRegex: /<li class="cl-static-search-result" title="([^"]*)">\s*<a href="([^"]+)"/g — groups: title, postUrl. Post URLs are now https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/{slug}/{base62Id} (NOT the old newyork.craigslist.org/mnh/fbh/d/{slug}/{numericId}.html the current src/lib/craigslist.ts parseIndex regex expects — that regex matched 0 links on test day and needs updating)
parseRecipe.cardExtras: inside each <li>: <div class="title">, <div class="location"> (e.g. "Chinatown / Lit Italy")
parseRecipe.detailPage: posting pages still serve <section id="postingbody">, <div class="mapaddress">, compensation <b> block — existing parseDetail() in src/lib/craigslist.ts keeps working once index URLs are fixed

refreshCadence: hourly-to-daily from a residential/whitelisted egress; from Vercel it 403s — degraded source, keep behind cache or proxy
notes: Fetched fine from this residential machine with a desktop UA. Known to 403 from Vercel datacenter IPs. 55/88 results bartender-titled (mnh=Manhattan subarea, fbh=food/beverage/hospitality).

name: Craigslist sapi JSON search API

parseRecipe.jsonPath: data.items[] — positional arrays mixing scalars and tagged tuples [tagId, value]: tag 6=url slug, 7=pay string ("$17-$20hr"), 8=venue name ("Asia Roma"), 12=role blurb, 13=base62 post id (build post URL as https://www.craigslist.org/view/d/{slug}/{base62Id}); last array element = full post title; element 4 is "lat~lon"-ish geo cluster string; data.totalResultCount for total
parseRecipe.scope: batch=3-0-360-0-0 → area 3 (NYC) all subareas; returned 216 items NYC-wide incl. Brooklyn — filter Manhattan by title/slug or use the HTML mnh page for strict Manhattan

refreshCadence: same as CL HTML — residential egress only; assume same datacenter blocking as craigslist.org
notes: This is the JSON the CL SPA itself loads — includes venue name + pay hint at the INDEX level (no detail fetch needed for a headline card). All 216 items matched query=bartender in fbh. Undocumented API: treat the tuple tags defensively (verify tag ids on each parse, fall back to HTML source).
